_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_enters_replacement.py. t_er_mox is Mox Diamond: an artifact whose own arrival is replaced by 'you may discard a land card instead', and which also carries a self_enters trigger so a test can prove the trigger never fires on a declined arrival. t_er_plain is the same artifact without the clause, the control. t_er_exiled sends the declined arrival to exile instead of a graveyard, so instead_zone is exercised. t_er_watcher watches every permanent that enters from the other side of the table. t_er_reanimate returns an artifact from a graveyard to the battlefield, and t_er_cheat puts one there from a hand -- the two non-cast arrivals.

If this artifact would enter, you may discard a land card instead. If you do, put this artifact onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard.
